title: Phone: Harwick Police PIO — statement at 13:30

transcript.speaker: Harwick Police PIO
transcript.text: We’re putting out a statement at one-thirty. It will say the operator was identified and cited for flying over people at a public event, and that he is associated with a local drone company. It won’t name the company.

transcript.speaker: Harwick Police PIO
transcript.text: You’ve been saying no Group aircraft were flying all morning. Do you want to say something before we do?

voiceStyles.Harwick Police PIO: Woman in her 30s, brisk and friendly

instructorNote: The decision point. Saying it first costs the Group a bad headline it controls; saying nothing leaves “no Group aircraft” looking like a dodge. Watch for a decision, its basis recorded, and the crew member taken off flight duties pending review.

snapshot.title: GM: Drone Payload Concern — Evacuation Decision

transcript.speaker: General Manager
transcript.text: This is the General Manager. We have received a report from a local resident that the drone may have a payload. Is there any evidence of a weapon or hazardous material? Should we evacuate Hangar 1 and the adjacent Horton Field?

transcript.speaker: Director of Flight Operations
transcript.text: Understood. I’m consulting the ASO and SCL now. We’ll confirm and update you within five minutes.

transcript.speaker: General Manager
transcript.text: Please confirm no telemetry or Remote ID data indicates a hazardous load. We need to assess risk to personnel and site integrity.

transcript.speaker: Director of Flight Operations
transcript.text: Confirmed. No payload data in the Remote ID feed. No telemetry suggests a weapon or hazardous material. We’re not detecting any anomalies in the broadcast pattern or aircraft behavior. I recommend no evacuation per HUOG-ERP Section 8.4: 'No evidence of threat or payload; operations remain suspended only if directed by law enforcement.'

transcript.speaker: General Manager
transcript.text: Acknowledged. I’ll monitor official updates. Do not initiate evacuation without a direct law enforcement directive.

voiceStyles.General Manager: Woman in her 50s, calm but urgent, slight pause after 'payload'
voiceStyles.Director of Flight Operations: Man in his 40s, steady, professional, with measured tone

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests the IC’s adherence to HUOG-ERP 8.4 and their ability to reject unnecessary actions based on incomplete evidence. Watch for overreaction or failure to reference policy.
